description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch with haste.
The token copy of Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
